title: A finite etale morphism is injective on fundamental groups
statement: Let $f:Y'\to Y$ be a finite etale morphism of connected schemes, $\bar y'$ a geometric point of $Y'$, $\bar y=f\circ\bar y'$, and $f_*:\pi_1(Y',\bar y')\to\pi_1(Y,\bar y)$ the continuous homomorphism of [lem-galois-pi1-functoriality]. Then $f_*$ is injective.
